roleKicker: Full-stack Software Engineer // Engineering Lead // Technical Writer
aboutMe: Hi, I’m Divine Orji. I’m a full-stack software engineer and Head of Engineering at The Kreativ Studio. I lead a remote team, but I still spend plenty of time writing code and getting it into production.

If you want to see what I build, start with Bonjour Quick Bites or Noma. One helps you order food for pickup or delivery; the other helps you study for a nursing exam. I also write technical guides and created the Alchemy Of Code curriculum to help you take an idea from a sketch to working software.
speakerBio: Divine Orji is a full-stack software engineer, technical writer, and Head of Engineering at The Kreativ Studio, where he leads a remote team and builds web products such as Bonjour Quick Bites and Noma. He writes hands-on guides for freeCodeCamp and created the software engineering curriculum behind Alchemy Of Code. At Innovation Growth Hub in Aba, he trained and mentored more than 100 web development students. His work focuses on building useful software and helping others learn to build their own.

selectedWork.title: Bonjour Quick Bites
selectedWork.summary: I built this online storefront so you can order bread, pastries, or hot meals in Port Harcourt and choose pickup or delivery. I used Next.js and TypeScript, Supabase for data, Better Auth for sign-in, and GitHub and Vercel for deployments.

selectedWork.title: Crunchies Online
selectedWork.summary: I led the redesign in Next.js and Tailwind CSS to make it easier to choose pickup or delivery, find an outlet on Google Maps, and check out. The work helped grow monthly online sales from ₦200,000 to over ₦3 million.

selectedWork.title: Alchemy Of Code
selectedWork.summary: I created this curriculum to help you go from learning the basics to building something from your own idea. The platform runs on Cloudflare with Supabase and Better Auth.

selectedWork.title: Noma
selectedWork.summary: I built Noma so you can review nursing concepts with flashcards, then take a quiz to see what you know and what you need to revisit.

selectedWork.title: The Iroko Circle
selectedWork.summary: I designed and built this WordPress site so you can discover African literature, submit a piece of your own, or find a local chapter.

An engineer whose deep technical knowledge shines in the content itself, with a way of explaining complex subjects that makes the material actually stick.
A dependable developer and writer who always meets deadlines with a high standard and close attention to detail.
A brilliant developer whose products are seamless and pixel-perfect, with writing that provides total clarity and a genuine passion for helping and mentoring new developers in the community.
A patient and understanding frontend developer who goes the extra mile, and a great leader who ensures everyone is carried along while constantly looking for opportunities to learn and improve.

projects.title: Crunchies Online
description: Crunchies Fried Chicken hired me to redesign its online ordering site over seven months. The redesign focused on checkout, especially how customers choose delivery or pickup and find the right outlet.

projects.title: Merphils
description: Merphils is a school management platform in development. The goal is to give staff tools for daily operations and let families and students access academic records without juggling separate accounts.

projects.title: Grooovy
description: Grooovy is an event platform in development for finding nights out you might otherwise hear about through friends or group chats. It brings public event listings, ticketing, and host tools together.

projects.title: Kadric Ltd
description: A UI improvement project for an existing industrial supplier website built with WordPress and Elementor.
I worked on an already-built brochure-style site, improving the interface, content placement, and overall clarity so the company's services and product range were easier to understand.
The updated forms give potential clients a clearer way to send enquiries, while the improved UI makes the site feel more polished, trustworthy, and easier to use.

projects.title: The Iroko Circle
description: The Iroko Circle brings readers and writers together around African literature. Its website publishes new writing and gives visitors ways to submit work, join a chapter, and sign up for the newsletter.

projects.title: The Bakistry
description: The Bakistry is a handcrafted cakes and treats brand built around fast delivery, premium presentation, and a warm storefront for everyday celebrations and special occasions.
The site combines category-led shopping, cart and checkout flows, featured products, and editorial content so customers can move easily from inspiration to order.
From Budget Express Cakes to custom gateaux, the experience is designed to balance appetite, speed, and visual delight without making the buying path feel heavy.

projects.title: The Developer Marketing Book
description: The Developer Marketing Book is a focused launch site for a book on reaching and engaging developers through strategy, community, and partnerships.
The site brings together the core value proposition, book formats, audiobook promotion, testimonials, and author credibility in one fast marketing surface.
Its structure is intentionally tight: help the right reader understand the promise quickly, browse proof, and take a clear next step toward purchase or listening.

projects.title: 7Star Unisex Beauty Palace
description: 7Star Unisex Beauty Palace is a Cairo-based hair studio specializing in professional dreadlocks, expert braiding, and dedicated hair care — from starter locs to protective styling.
The website was built to give the studio a professional digital presence that reflects its emphasis on healthy hair, proper technique, and personalized client care.

WhatsApp-based booking is integrated throughout the service pages so visitors can move from exploring treatments to scheduling an appointment in one smooth step, while client reviews, blog content, and product listings extend the relationship beyond the first visit.
